body.name: Known-information spectral-threshold OLS
body.construction: Form \(H_n(\varepsilon)=\Sigma_k(d^\star)^{-1/2}(F^{\mathsf T}F/n)\Sigma_k(d^\star)^{-1/2}-I_q\); on \(G_n(\varepsilon)=\{\|H_n(\varepsilon)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\varepsilon\}\), set \(\widehat\beta_{\varepsilon}=(F^{\mathsf T}F)^{-1}F^{\mathsf T}Y\), and set it to zero on the complement.
